summary: The customer is looking to explore an in situ optical spectroscopy pilot to monitor glucose and lactate in a cell culture process as an alternative to delayed laboratory sample testing.

facts_stated.text: The process is a cell culture operating in an aqueous medium.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: cell culture process in an aqueous medium

facts_stated.text: Glucose and lactate are currently measured via offline sampling with delayed results.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Glucose and lactate are measured from samples, and the delay makes it difficult to see changes promptly.

facts_stated.text: The customer wants to pilot in situ spectroscopy and validate it against existing lab measurements.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We are exploring an in situ spectroscopy pilot that can be checked against those existing laboratory measurements.

facts_stated.text: Medium composition and cell population vary over the course of the process run.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The medium and cell population change during the run

facts_stated.text: No optical probe or calibration model has been selected yet.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: we have not yet selected a probe or a calibration strategy.

process.value: medium and cell population change during the run
process.enquiry_quote: The medium and cell population change during the run
